Description: Unique numeric identifier for each registered user account.
The first (given) name of the user.
The last (family) name of the user.
The email address of the user. Used for login and notifications. Should be unique per user.
The street address of the user for shipping purposes.
The US ZIP code associated with the user's address.
Unique numeric identifier for each credit card on file.
The full credit card number. NOTE: Storing full PAN is a PCI-DSS violation; should be tokenized.
The expiration date of the credit card.
Foreign key linking this credit card to the owning user.
Unique numeric identifier for each sneaker listing on the platform.
Foreign key referencing the UserID of the seller who created this listing.
Internal product catalog identifier. Links to a product master (not yet modeled).
The type/category of the sneaker (e.g., Running, Basketball, Casual). NOTE: Named 'Type' in im.Items.
The brand name of the sneaker (e.g., Nike, Adidas). NOTE: Named 'BrandName' in im.Items.
The primary color of the sneaker.
Target gender for the sneaker: M (Men), W (Women), U (Unisex). NOTE: Named 'Sex' in im.Items.
The US shoe size of the sneaker (e.g., 10, 10.5, 11).
The condition of the sneaker as assessed by SneakerPark (e.g., New, Like New, Good, Fair).
The asking price or starting bid price set by the seller, in USD.
The type of listing: fixed price sale or auction bidding.
The date on which the listing was created and made active on the platform.
The date on which the listing expired or was closed. NULL if still active.
Unique numeric identifier for each order placed on the platform.
Foreign key referencing the UserID of the buyer who placed the order.
Foreign key referencing the credit card used to pay for this order.
The shipping cost charged to the buyer for this order, in USD.
The tax rate applied to this order, expressed as an integer percentage.
The total amount charged to the buyer including item price, shipping, and tax, in USD.
The delivery address for this order. May differ from the buyer's registered address.
The ZIP code of the shipping destination.
The date and time when the order was placed.
The current fulfillment status of the order (e.g., Pending, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled). Free-text — no enforced vocabulary.
Part of composite primary key. Foreign key to op.Orders.
Part of composite primary key. Foreign key to li.listings.
The final price at which this listing sold, in USD. May differ from ListingPrice (e.g., auction).
Unique numeric identifier for each shipment record.
Foreign key linking this shipment to its parent order.
The shipping carrier used to deliver the order (e.g., UPS, FedEx, USPS).
The carrier-issued tracking number for the shipment. NULL if not yet assigned.
The date on which the order was physically shipped from SneakerPark's warehouse.
Unique numeric identifier assigned to each pair of sneakers upon arrival at the warehouse.
A descriptive name for the sneaker item (e.g., brand + model).
The UserID of the seller who shipped this item to SneakerPark. NOTE: No FK constraint enforced.
The type/category of the sneaker. NOTE: Named 'ShoeType' in li.listings — inconsistency.
The brand of the sneaker. NOTE: Named 'Brand' in li.listings — inconsistency.
The primary color of the sneaker.
The US shoe size of the sneaker.
The target gender for the sneaker. NOTE: Named 'Gender' in li.listings — inconsistency.
The physical condition of the sneaker as assessed upon arrival.
The current status of the item in the warehouse (e.g., Received, Authenticated, Listed, Sold, Returned).
The date the sneaker arrived at SneakerPark's warehouse.
Unique numeric identifier for each customer service ticket. NOTE: Should be renamed 'RequestID'.
The UserID of the user who submitted the request. NOTE: No FK constraint to usr.users.
First name of the user. NOTE: Duplicated from usr.users — data redundancy and consistency risk.
Last name of the user. NOTE: Duplicated from usr.users — data redundancy and consistency risk.
The reason for the customer's contact (e.g., Shipping Issue, Wrong Item, Refund Request). Free-text.
Email address provided by the customer during the support interaction. May be NULL.
Phone number provided by the customer. May be NULL.
The OrderID related to this support request. May be NULL if not order-related.
The resolution provided by the support agent (e.g., Refund Issued, Replacement Sent). Free-text.
The channel through which the customer contacted support (e.g., Phone, Email, Chat).
